chapter: Jump for Joy and the Harlem clubs
title: Cotton Club, Connie's Inn and Small's Paradise shows
summary: Cotton Club shows were good when stars like Ethel Waters or Peg Leg Bates appeared; Connie's Inn, run by gangsters, and Small's Paradise also had good shows.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: How did you feel about the Cotton Club shows? Were they good? (Inaudible)?
The Cotton Club? Sure, Some of them were when they had a big star like Ethel Waters or people like that. Peg Leg Bates. It was a very good show.
Connie's Inn had good shows too. Oh, that was run by gangsters. Small's Paradise, too, had good shows.
Oh, yeah, it was big, uh-huh.
Oh, I saw it in later years.
